hook: Read an article on studying abroad and weigh its pros and cons the way the writer does, signpost by signpost.
intro: A magazine text about a semester abroad, built as a balanced argument in three paragraphs: advantages (a language learnt in everyday life, friends, independence), difficulties (loneliness at first, everything foreign, the language in lectures, the cost), and the conclusion most students reach, with a short quotation from a student called Lena. It is the kind of text you find in student magazines and university guides, and it carries the vocabulary of study — das Studium, das Semester, das Stipendium, die Vorlesung, selbstständig — plus the genitive in natural use: am Anfang des Semesters, die beste Entscheidung meines Lebens. The six questions ask who helps, why you become independent, one difficulty, the problem at the start of the semester, Lena’s first weeks and the conclusion. Look for the signposts: … hat viele Vorteile, Natürlich gibt es auch …, Aber die meisten …
tips[0].title: Signposts of a balanced text
tips[0].text: … hat viele Vorteile (a list follows) · Natürlich gibt es auch Schwierigkeiten (the other side follows) · Außerdem (one more point) · Aber die meisten … sagen später, dass … (the conclusion).
tips[0].check.why: Außerdem means 'besides, also': it adds another point to the list, here another difficulty.
tips[0].visual.moves[0].label: For
tips[0].visual.moves[1].label: Against
tips[0].visual.moves[2].label: Weighing
tips[1].title: Reading the genitive
tips[1].text: am Anfang des Semesters, die beste Entscheidung meines Lebens — des / der / meines + noun after another noun = "of the / of my". Recognise it and read on.
tips[1].check.why: der Universität after a noun is genitive: 'the library of the university'.
tips[2].title: man = you / one
tips[2].text: Man lernt eine neue Sprache, man findet Freunde, man wird selbstständiger: the impersonal man carries general statements and takes the er-form of the verb.
tips[2].check.why: man takes the er/sie/es form of the verb: man findet.
remember[0]: Vorteile → Schwierigkeiten → aber die meisten: the argument’s route.
remember[1]: des / der / meines after a noun = "of the / of my".
exam: Balanced magazine texts like this are a standard reading text in the B1 exam — and exactly what you read before deciding to study abroad.
tips[0].check.q: 'Außerdem ist das Leben in der Stadt sehr teuer.' What does Außerdem tell you?
tips[0].check.options[0]: One more point on the same side follows
tips[0].check.options[1]: The text switches to the other side
tips[0].check.answer: One more point on the same side follows
